title: EOS release manifest
description:
What a release actually contains. Without one, the release gate had to assume EVERY story under docs/stories/ belonged to EVERY release: a story finished a year ago was re-verified against each new candidate, two release trains could not exist at once, and a hotfix dragged unrelated work with it. This file makes membership explicit and reviewable, and binds it to the candidate it was decided for.

It records the PLAN. It never records outcomes: approvals live in the hash-chained ledger and are bound to this file's digest, so editing the manifest invalidates them rather than inheriting them.

releaseId.description: Must match the scope id the release gate is run for.

candidateCommit.description: The commit this manifest was written for. When present EOS requires HEAD to match at verification time, so a manifest cannot silently follow the branch forward.

productTreeDigest.description: The product tree this manifest was written for (`eos product-tree --json`). Optional on first authoring; recorded by `eos release bind`.

includedStories.description: Exactly the stories this release ships. Each must exist, be verified, and its verification must describe the candidate tree. An empty list is legal only for a release that ships no story work (state why in `note`).

excludedStories.description: Stories deliberately NOT in this release. A reason is required: 'not in this release' is a decision, and a decision that is not written down is indistinguishable from an oversight.

artifactRefs.description: What is actually shipped — an image digest, a package version, a bundle checksum.

requiredEvidence.description: Evidence kinds this release requires beyond the gate defaults. A project raises its own bar here; EOS never lowers one.

requiredApprovals.description: How many separate approvers this release needs. The approvals themselves are ledger events bound to this manifest's digest — they are never recorded in this file, which is hand-editable.

artifacts.description: What ships, by content: each built file and its SHA-256, recorded by `eos release bind`. Provenance must name every one of them.

sbom.description: The SBOM this release was bound to, by content digest.

ledger.description: The ledger event the release was cut from. The chain must still contain it, unchanged.

provenance.description: Provenance files for the artifacts (in-toto / DSSE / Sigstore bundle). EOS checks offline that they name every artifact by digest; their own signatures are verified by `gh attestation verify`.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical content (everything but this block), by the key in release.signing.publicKey. `eos release sign` writes it.

supersedes.description: For a hotfix or a re-cut candidate: the release id this one replaces.
